company.name: Plume Design
company.shortDescription: Plume is a SaaS platform that provides the delivery of technological services for connected homes.
company.description:
Plume is a software-as-a-service platform for communications service providers (CSPs) that enables the delivery of services for connected homes. Its platform serves connected homes, delivering features like optimum Wi-Fi, parental controls, and motion sensing to smart home residents while giving communication service providers back-end applications to provide support.

Founded in 2015, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Plume Design is researching computerized systems and methods for an energy aware adaptive network and energy management in Wi Fi networks and smart homes that optimize connected home performance. Work such as systems and methods for an adaptive smart mesh topology and optimization of distributed Wi Fi networks focuses on cloud based control, multi link operation and automated modification of wireless networks. Additional efforts address home security via a Wi Fi network and Wi Fi network based interactive gaming. Overall, Plume develops adaptive networking, security, energy and interactive services.
